description.en: Shorthand for CreateEvLowMdlForCharaNo_NPCOnly with its _no_bustup argument forced to true — creates a low-detail predefined-NPC cutscene model without its bustup portrait.
Name to assign the created model.
NPC number identifying the predefined character to create.
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a low-detail predefined-NPC model without a bustup portrait
local hNpcL = CreateEvLowMdlForCharaNo_NPCOnlyNoBustup("npcL", 12);
